title: The Thief in Camp
text: Someone has been through the packs in the night, very neatly, folding everything back. Small footprints lead off into the dark, bare and narrow, with too many toes. Things are missing, and whoever took them knew exactly what to look for.

options.label: The quickest follows the small footprints, to take back what was stolen.

outcomes.text: A goblin, and a nest of stolen things.

options.label: Count what is missing and move on. Chasing it is what it wants.

outcomes.text: Food, mostly. And a little of everyone's coin, and the straps cut neat.

options.label: The craftiest leaves bait for tomorrow night, and waits.

outcomes.text: It comes back, and stays caught, and tells you what it knows.
